source.capture: Supplied Double V Consulting article (author wanyixu, 2025-08-05). Brand introduction reports an estimated US$250 million annual retail sales/revenue, 73% female consumers and US$89–900 prices; its inconsistent sales labels and absent period/methodology prevent financial verification. Product section describes a removable washable decorative cover over a non-slip pad, plus design collaborations and room/size variants. Marketing section describes lifestyle/UGC content and creator allowlisting, asserting better acquisition results without quantitative support. Traffic section lists 4.56 million monthly visits with no observation date or provider. My Initial Notes proposes a maintenance-pain + engineering + lifestyle-branding formula; it is an owner interpretation, separate from the article.

claims.text: The article describes a removable machine-washable decorative cover over a non-slip pad.
